subject: Field Enablement Sprint - Datadog Reseller Accelerator
messages:
From: Anita Shah <anita@datadog.com>
To: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Datadog Partnerships <partnerships@datadog.com>
Date: Sat, 18 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Datadog x Redwood - reseller accelerator kickoff

Hi Marissa,

Thanks again for the quick intro this week. Datadog is excited to pilot a resell + co-sell "Field Enablement Accelerator" with Redwood to accelerate wins with three shared mid-market accounts in Q3.

High-level ask: can your team run a 2-week technical enablement sprint with our catalog/AE teams, and then a 4-week joint field play cadence (enablement -> joint demos -> pilot handoff)?

We have a short checklist and a couple of standard templates (co-marketing brief, partner tech checklist) — I attached the checklist and I'm happy to jump on a planning call next week.

Proposed dates: Aug 3–14 for the technical sprint; Aug 17 start for field cadence.

Would you be able to confirm by EOD Tuesday?

Thanks,
Anita Shah
Partnerships Manager, Datadog
Anita Shah | anita@datadog.com

Attachments: technical-checklist-datadog.pdf (1 page checklist)

From: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwoodinference.com>, ben_carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>, grace_oconnor <grace_oconnor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 18 Jul 2026 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Datadog x Redwood - reseller accelerator kickoff

Team — forwarding Anita's note from Datadog. This looks like a high-leverage partner activation but we need to be prescriptive on scope and customer list.

Quick asks:
- Vanessa: can you own GTM cadence + co-marketing ask?
- Ben: can you scope the demo kit + reference infra we'd need?
- Grace: can you own the enablement content (playbook + runbooks)?

I sketched a 2-week technical sprint deliverable list (attached: field-enablement-sprint-plan.xlsx). Please review and push back by Tuesday so we can confirm dates.

Notes: we should ask for a named Datadog SE and a matrix of which accounts they'll prioritize. Also request their SOC2 scope doc for any pre-sales access if needed.

Marissa
Director, Alliances | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0148

Subject: Re: Fwd: Datadog x Redwood - reseller accelerator kickoff

Marissa / team / Anita —

Thanks — I reviewed the sprint plan. A few quick clarifications before we lock dates:

1) Co-marketing: we can commit a one-pager + joint webinar. Need Datadog to provide customer logos + copy approvals 5 business days before webinar.
2) Field staffing: Ben, please confirm demo kit + infra (envs, sample datasets). Datadog, can you confirm a named SE (and whether they can join customer discovery calls)?
3) Legal/Procurement: We will not sign any reseller contract until we have the co-sell motion defined — can Partnerships share the standard reseller T&Cs?

Anita — attaching our proposed sprint plan with minor edits (I highlighted the webinar milestone). If OK, I'll schedule the planning call for Aug 2.

- Vanessa
Sr. Partner Marketing Manager | Redwood Inference

Marissa / Vanessa / team —

Great — confirming the following from our side:

- Named SE: Kunal Mehta (kunal.mehta@datadog.com) will be technical lead and can join up to two customer discovery calls during the sprint.
- Reseller T&Cs: attaching a redacted reseller term summary; procurement will need standard PO + one-page SOW for services.
- SOC2: we can share our auditor attestation for pre-sales access; Kunal will coordinate any necessary access.
- DocuSign: I circulated a co-marketing MOU via DocuSign (link below) — not a contract, just marketing approvals so we can list Redwood in joint materials.

Quick answers to technical checklist: Datadog expects integrations via OTLP and recommends we expose a small demo bucket with sample traces/metrics. They also recommend a simple dashboard template (we can pre-seed).

DocuSign link: https://docusign.com/overview/abc123 (Anita note: placeholder link)
HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/123456/deal/4591

Happy to jump on Aug 2th planning call — propose 09:00 PT.

Thanks,
Anita

- Grace: draft enablement playbook + dashboard templates by Aug 1.
- Vanessa: schedule webinar milestone and secure co-marketing approvals (due Aug 10).
- Anita / Kunal: share SOC2 attestation and SE availability calendar (Kunal to join Aug 4 discovery).

I've updated the HubSpot deal with the milestones and uploaded the sprint plan: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/123456/deal/4591
